purpose: Reconcile source attribution against Hamza’s actual directory without replacing baseline records or changing their verification dates.

method.directoryLinks: Read via direct HTTPS source for all three category pages and compared with every local record URL.
method.representativeDetails: Read direct HTML source for Melbourne, Bristol, King’s College Hospital and St Thomas’ Hospital.
method.scopeLimit: This is source and route reconciliation, not a new verification of every room’s current conditions.

countCautions: The homepage’s 366-airport count excludes pending airports; it must not replace the directory’s 414-airport total.
The hospital directory has 32 checked and 13 still checking; all 45 records are retained.

representativeListings.facts: Two round-the-clock spaces are listed, one before security between T2/T3 at ground level, the other beyond security in T2 opposite Cafe Sol.
representativeListings.previousExtraTip: Experience Ambassador wayfinding does not appear on Hamza’s MEL listing. The independent airport article supports it, but the displayed field note now uses the two rooms from Hamza’s listing instead.

representativeListings.facts: Woodland Prayer Rooms at 21 Woodland Road require Ucard activation via chaplaincy email for all-hours access.
representativeListings.researchCorrection: The earlier quiet-threshold research incorrectly described Bristol as absent after looking only in universities.json. It exists in universities-2.json and on Hamza’s live directory; the Ucard advice was already present in both.

representativeListings.facts: Limited capacity restricts the multi-faith room to patients, relatives during the patient’s stay, and staff. Access is through ward staff.
representativeListings.previousExtraTip: Ashford/St Peter’s is not listed in Hamza’s hospital directory. Its independently sourced security-unlock example is replaced in the displayed field note by this St Thomas’ access restriction.

representativeListings.facts: Hamza’s listing does not confirm a Muslim chaplain. The preview’s existing adapter uses a separately attributed VisitInsights source that does.
representativeListings.attributionCaution: Do not imply the preview’s independent Muslim-support overlay or other supplemental research was copied from Hamza or freshly verified as part of this task.

preservedStrengths: Specific location and access details remain beside primary citations.
Unknown, not listed, pending and checked records remain distinct.
Existing qibla, nearby-masjid, halal-source, planner, visitor-report and photo tools are kept.
Hamza’s directory remains identified as independent of the listed institutions.

implementation.integration: Render SourceProvenance once with the current Astro pathname and locale below the guide. It links only home/category or actual observed listing paths, strips language prefixes and search fragments, and labels originals as English in translated interfaces.
implementation.separation: The attribution states that additional guidance and artwork have separate credits. Field-note highlights now cite exact original directory listings; institutional links remain in existing place records. No check date is added.
